title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
desc: Token transfers should be gated by identity verification.
snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "ERC-3643: invalid identity");

title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
desc: Before transfers the token should invoke compliance.canTransfer to enforce rules.
snippet: require(compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount), "ERC-3643: compliance failed");

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
desc: Claim Topics Registry should expose management functions and emit the standard add/remove events.
snippet: function addClaimTopic(uint256 _claimTopic); event ClaimTopicAdded(uint256 indexed claimTopic);

title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
desc: Identity Registry should wire the ClaimTopicsRegistry via setter and expose the stored address.
snippet: function setClaimTopicsRegistry(address _claimTopics);

title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
desc: Identity Registry must reference the Trusted Issuers Registry through the official setter.
snippet: function setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address _trustedIssuers);

title: IdentityRegistry must expose isVerified view function
desc: Identity Registry should implement isVerified and the token should point to the configured registry.
snippet: function isVerified(address userAddress) external view returns (bool);

title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
desc: Token should emit events when wiring the identity registry and compliance modules.
snippet:
event IdentityRegistryAdded(address indexed identityRegistry);
event ComplianceAdded(address indexed compliance);

title: Token must support freezing and unfreezing addresses
desc: Token should include freeze management primitives required by ERC-3643.
snippet:
function setAddressFrozen(address _who, bool _frozen);
function freezePartialTokens(address _who, uint256 _amount);

title: Token must be ERC-20 compatible
desc: ERC-3643 tokens should fully implement the ERC-20 surface.
snippet: function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool); function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

title: Token must support investor recovery functionality
desc: Token should expose the recovery flow and emit the corresponding success event.
snippet:
function recoveryAddress(address _lostWallet, address _newWallet, address _onchainID);
event RecoverySuccess(address indexed _lostWallet, address indexed _newWallet, address indexed _investor);

title: Token must expose identity/compliance wiring functions
desc: The security token should wire and update the linked identity registry and compliance contracts.
snippet:
function setIdentityRegistry(address _identityRegistry);
function setCompliance(address _compliance);

title: Token must manage agent roles and emit events
desc: ERC-3643 requires agent role management on the token, including add/remove operations and audit events.

title: Token must support pause/unpause controls
desc: The token should be pausable with explicit pause/unpause functions and events for compliance oversight.

title: Token must emit freeze management events
desc: Freeze/unfreeze controls require dedicated events so operators can audit address-level freezes.

title: Token must support mint, burn, and forced transfers
desc: ERC-3643 tokens require controlled supply adjustments and emergency forced transfers.

title: Token must support batch administrative operations
desc: The token interface defines batch variants for transfers, freezes, mint/burn, and agent controls.

title: Token must expose investor identity metadata controls
desc: Token name, symbol, and on-chain identity must be mutable with corresponding audit event.

title: IdentityRegistry must manage agent roles with events
desc: Identity registry contracts also expose agent controls mirroring the token requirements.

title: IdentityRegistry must support identity lifecycle management
desc: Registering, updating, deleting, and batching identities are core ERC-3643 requirements.

title: IdentityRegistry must manage investor country data
desc: Country information drives jurisdictional compliance and must be retrievable and updatable.

title: IdentityRegistry must link IdentityRegistryStorage
desc: The identity registry should expose its storage contract, setter, and emit the linkage event.

title: IdentityRegistry must emit registry linkage events
desc: Changes to trusted issuers or claim topics registries must emit dedicated events.
snippet:
event ClaimTopicsRegistrySet(address indexed claimTopicsRegistry);
event TrustedIssuersRegistrySet(address indexed trustedIssuersRegistry);

title: IdentityRegistry must emit identity lifecycle events
desc: Investor identity creation, updates, and removals require auditable events.

title: IdentityRegistryStorage must provide identity storage primitives
desc: The storage contract should add, modify, remove identities and bind/unbind registries with events.

title: TrustedIssuersRegistry must cover issuer lifecycle
desc: Trusted issuers registry should add, remove, and update issuers and emit lifecycle events.

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must expose ownership controls
desc: Registry ownership transferability is required for governance handover.

title: Compliance contract must manage modules and transfer hooks
desc: Modular compliance must bind the token, manage modules, and expose hooks per ERC-3643.

title: Compliance contract must emit module lifecycle events
desc: Binding tokens and managing modules must trigger events for auditability.

title: Compliance contract must remain bound to the target token
desc: The modular compliance contract should report the audited token address.
snippet: require(compliance.getTokenBound() == address(this), "ERC-3643: compliance not bound");

title: Token's compliance pointer must match configuration
desc: The token should reference the expected compliance contract address.
snippet: require(address(compliance()) == expectedCompliance, "ERC-3643: unexpected compliance");

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must contain at least one claim topic
desc: A compliant deployment should define the minimum claim topics used for eligibility checks.
snippet: require(claimTopics.length > 0, "ERC-3643: missing claim topics");
